parts.headline: OpenAI and Anthropic Are Not the Same Business

mentions.excerpt: On August 9, Wyndo published step-by-step instructions for pointing Anthropic’s coding tool at DeepSeek’s servers.
Four days later, Wyndo described a council of models reviewing the same decision and said he had changed his mind about open-weight systems handling hard reasoning.
